operating_policy_adoption.refresh_rule: 다음 작업에서는 최신 main과 drift를 다시 확인한다. 이번 SHA는 채택 출처이지 영구 최신 기준이 아니며 release lock 전체를 조용히 교체하지 않는다.

conditional_routes.action: 기존 승인·계획·기록을 재사용한다. 새 대형 작업만 필요한 plan을 보강한다.
프로젝트 등가 owner/검사를 사용한다. Base 전체 scaffold나 다른 adapter schema를 설치하지 않는다.
GDD 재미·표현 검증 기준의 같은 requirement ID로 연결한다. 작은 변경은 한 단락.
GDD 경험 원본에서 상태·입력·표현·실제 consumer·실패/복귀·검증까지 구체화한다.
현재 호스트의 해당 SKILL.md와 필요한 참조만 읽는다. 승인 자산 보호, 크로마키/alpha와 상태군 검증.
현재 경로/연결 확인 후 QA 관측만. 기존 CLI fallback 가능. 전역/설치 변경 없음.
기존 월간 PDF에 누적. 실제 발행/검증 경로가 없으면 미발행으로 기록.

project_adaptations.human_facing_canon: docs/design/PROJECT_GDD.md is the current human-facing canon. A PDF remains a derived snapshot and is not regenerated by an operations-only task.
project_adaptations.structured_runtime_truth: The existing GDD, current Godot handoff, visual inventory, GDScript, scenes, resources, tests, and repository evidence stay as separate owners. This adapter does not duplicate their product facts.
project_adaptations.base_reuse_modules: docs/base-reuse-adoption.json remains the Base reuse-module manifest only. A module is enabled only after a real project destination, lock, consumer, and verification exist.
project_adaptations.godot_authoring_and_qa: Keep the project's current Godot 4.7 source/test/runtime routes. Do not install HiGodot, GUT, Hera, or a Base helper merely because Base describes an optional route.
project_adaptations.continuation: A same-scope user approval may continue safe research, implementation, machine/runtime verification, correction, documentation, cleanup, and branch synchronization. New player meaning, public social scope, cost, permission, destructive migration, or Human UX approval stays separately gated.
project_adaptations.read_order: 프로젝트 사용자/AGENTS→GDD/handoff→latest main/실제 consumer/PR→채택 adapter→필요 Base. Base START_HERE의 일반 순서보다 프로젝트 순서 우선.
project_adaptations.record_shape: 기존 handoff가 승인·작업 순서·검증·판단·남은 작업을 소유. Base root receipt/kanban 전체 설치는 비채택. project-local contract test와 실제 review/readback을 사용.
project_adaptations.skill_boundary: 프로젝트에 tracked SKILL.md 없음. 새 wrapper 복제 없이 조건부 route로 연결. 설치 plugin/global skill은 수정하지 않으며 상위 지침을 우회하지 않는다.

work_sequence: reuse valid evidence and approved brief
impact checks and independent review with shared budget
normal current-task PR merge and main readback
append existing handoff/log and recalculate remaining work
explicit_non_adoptions: Base directory scaffolding or required-entrypoint paths that would relocate stable project owners
Notion or Google Sheets as an active project canon or required synchronization target
Automatic Base module vendoring without a named project consumer and Base adoption lock
Mandatory installation of HiGodot, GUT, Hera, a new MCP, a paid tool, or a second persistent editor authority
Automatic adoption of open Base PRs, draft proposals, or newer Base main content as project canon
Base-wide gameplay rules, visual grammar, save schema, character identity, asset path, or evidence claims
Universal fun score, compulsory retries/reward density or combat examples for this healing game
A new fun-supervisor skill, analytics server, or automatic Human PASS
Legacy five-review minimum and three alternatives for every mechanical fix
protected_scope: approved player, companion, boat, and visual asset provenance
existing save IDs and local persistence behavior
Human/device comfort and release evidence ceilings
open PR #19 and all unrelated workstreams

validation.runtime_rule: Run Godot import/scene/runtime checks only when the approved change affects a Godot runtime consumer; documentation-only contract refreshes do not claim new gameplay evidence.
validation.ceiling: Contract/link checks are not agent-compliance, Godot runtime, Human fun, or release evidence.

rollback: 새 운영 규칙 PR만 revert한다. #107 복구와 별개이며 구형 continuation branch/자산/세이브/plugin/Base 원본을 덮어쓰지 않는다.
